item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Shocked Face Gaming Thumbnail

turns.text: Make me a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for a gaming challenge. Big shocked face on the right, the three words “ONE LAST TRY” on the left. Invent the person. Bright and punchy.

item.tests: Tests composing a generated face and exact three-word typography into one readable widescreen thumbnail.

answer_sheet.Person and expression: An invented person with a shocked expression; other details are your call.
answer_sheet.Headline: ONE LAST TRY
answer_sheet.Platform, size and layout: YouTube thumbnail, 16:9; face on the right and text on the left. Free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Style and background: Bright, punchy gaming style; specific colours and background are your call.

must_haves: A large, clearly visible human face on the right with a shocked expression.
The headline reads exactly “ONE LAST TRY”, with no additional words.
The headline sits on the left, is high-contrast and does not cover the face.

turns.text: make me a thumbnail for a gaming challenge

dialog.agent: What game and challenge is the thumbnail for? For example: **“Minecraft, but I only have one heart”** or **“Fortnite—winning with no weapons.”**
dialog.why: It asks which game and challenge the thumbnail is for, and waits for the user’s details.

turns.agent:
I picked **Minecraft: ONE HEART CHALLENGE**, but Magic Hour refused the generation because your account doesn’t have enough credits. No image was created.

The concept: a shocked player facing a creeper over a lava ravine, one glowing red pixel heart, and bold white-and-yellow **“ONE HEART CHALLENGE”** text.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create an eye-catching professional YouTube gaming challenge thumbnail, wide 16:9 composition. Minecraft-inspired blocky voxel 3D game art. Left foreground: expressive blocky adventurer with dark hair, teal shirt, terrified shocked face, clutching a diamond sword, leaning away from danger. Right foreground: large threatening green creeper about to explode, surrounded by bright orange sparks and dynamic lighting, no gore. Background: dramatic lava ravine and dark cave, simplified and slightly defocused so foreground reads clearly at small sizes. Top center/right feature ONE single large bright glowing red pixel heart with black outline, communicating only one health heart left. Add exact large headline 'ONE HEART' in bold white block lettering with thick black stroke across upper left, and 'CHALLENGE' in bright yellow bold block lettering along bottom, safely within margins, highly legible. Strong separation of character and creeper, saturated cyan versus orange palette, dramatic rim lighting, clean uncluttered design, exciting high stakes, polished rendered game art. No additional text, no watermarks, no logos, no interface clutter.
